mapper.select: select TT.booksetId, TT.subjectNo, TT.balanceDate, TT.balFlag, sum(oAmt) as oAmt, sum(oDAmt) as oDAmt, sum(oCAmt) as oCAmt from ( select bb.bookset_id as booksetId, /*账套代码*/ SUBSTR(bb.subject_no,1,4) as subjectNo, /*科目号*/ bb.balance_date as balanceDate, /*余额日期*/ bb.bal_flag as balFlag, /*余额方向*/ NVL(bb.o_amt, 0) as oAmt, /*原币余额*/ NVL(bb.o_d_amt, 0) as oDAmt, /*原币余额借方*/ NVL(bb.o_c_amt, 0) as oCAmt/*原币余额贷方*/ from BOK_BALANCE bb INNER JOIN REP_PROD_INFO RP ON BB.BOOKSET_ID=RP.F_PROD_ID where RP.PROD_ID = #{booksetId} and bb.balance_date = #{balanceDate} ) TT GROUP BY TT.booksetId,TT.subjectNo,TT.balanceDate,TT.balFlag

SELECT proj_name projName, proj_code projCode, proj_level projLevel, subject_no subjectNo, crdr_flg crdrFlg, formula, show_flg showFlg, show_order showOrder FROM REP_BOK_PROFIT_REP_CONFIG where PROJ_TYPE='01' order by proj_code
